name: Mirokai
def: Character styled service robot that balances on a single ball, trialled in Paris hospitals for carrying samples, linens and small deliveries.
body: Mirokai is a humanoid upper body with two arms and an animated face that rides on a ball balancing drive rather than legs or a wheeled chassis, letting it pivot in place in narrow corridors. Enchanted Tools designed it deliberately as a fictional character, with a puppet inspired head and voice, on the argument that people accept a stylised robot more readily than an imitation human. It carries trays and containers, driven by a mix of autonomous navigation and remote operator support. The company has run trials in Paris hospitals and shown the robot at CES, but it is not yet a volume product.
facts: Trialled in Paris hospitals for internal transport of samples and supplies
Ball balancing drive lets it turn on the spot in narrow corridors
Designed as a stylised fictional character rather than a human likeness
specs: Ball balancing single sphere drive with two electric arms
Depth cameras, lidar, microphone array, animated face display
Autonomous indoor navigation with remote operator assistance
